# vktSynchronizationOperationMultiQueueTests

## Overview

**Core question:** Does synchronization make a write on one Vulkan queue visible to a read on another queue?

This page covers the multi-queue operation tests implemented in [`vktSynchronizationOperationMultiQueueTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/synchronization/vktSynchronizationOperationMultiQueueTests.cpp). The same factory is registered under both `synchronization.op.multi_queue` (legacy synchronization) and `synchronization2.op.multi_queue` (synchronization2). Cases combine a fence, binary semaphore, or timeline semaphore with a supported write/read operation pair, resource, and queue pair.

## Registration Hierarchy

```text
synchronization.op.multi_queue
├── fence
├── binary_semaphore
└── timeline_semaphore
```

Operation-pair groups and generated resource leaves appear below each primitive in both categories. The synchronization2 registration has the same three direct primitive families and additionally dispatches the `intermediate_barrier_use_all` family, which is described below. The parent registration is [`OperationTests::init`](../../../modules/vulkan/synchronization/vktSynchronizationTests.cpp#L83-L87); the factory creates `multi_queue` at [`createSynchronizedOperationMultiQueueTests`](../../../modules/vulkan/synchronization/vktSynchronizationOperationMultiQueueTests.cpp#L1657-L1664).

## Generated Case Dimensions

- **Primitive:** `fence`, `binary_semaphore`, or `timeline_semaphore`.
- **Operations:** one entry from `s_writeOps` and one from `s_readOps`, pruned when unsupported by the resource or queue flags.
- **Resource:** supported buffers, images, indirect buffers, and index buffers from the shared resource table.
- **Sharing:** `_exclusive` uses queue-family ownership transfer when required; `_concurrent` uses `VK_SHARING_MODE_CONCURRENT`.
- **Maintenance9:** non-Vulkan-SC concurrent cases add `_concurrent_maintenance9`, require `VK_KHR_maintenance9`, and consult `VkQueueFamilyOwnershipTransferPropertiesKHR` before deciding whether QFOT is needed.
- **Use-all-stages:** synchronization2 binary-semaphore exclusive buffer/image cases add `_exclusive_use_all_stages` (non-Vulkan-SC), requiring `VK_KHR_maintenance8` and `VK_DEPENDENCY_QUEUE_FAMILY_OWNERSHIP_TRANSFER_USE_ALL_STAGES_BIT_KHR`.

The matrix is generated by [`createTests`](../../../modules/vulkan/synchronization/vktSynchronizationOperationMultiQueueTests.cpp#L1444-L1644). Unsupported operation/resource combinations do not create leaves.

## Test Families

### `fence`

Submits the write with a fence, waits for completion, then submits the read on the selected read queue. See [`FenceTestInstance`](../../../modules/vulkan/synchronization/vktSynchronizationOperationMultiQueueTests.cpp#L1124-L1230).

### `binary_semaphore`

Signals a binary semaphore after the write submission and waits on it before the read submission. This is the main family for cross-queue QFOT and the sync2 `use_all_stages` variant. See [`BinarySemaphoreTestInstance`](../../../modules/vulkan/synchronization/vktSynchronizationOperationMultiQueueTests.cpp#L572-L918).

### `timeline_semaphore`

Uses increasing timeline values to chain work across the selected queues, including intermediate copy operations. See [`TimelineSemaphoreTestInstance`](../../../modules/vulkan/synchronization/vktSynchronizationOperationMultiQueueTests.cpp#L919-L1123).

### `intermediate_barrier_use_all` (sync2 only, non-Vulkan-SC)

The synchronization2 dispatcher registers this family, while the implementation is covered by the operation framework page. It adds extra read/write operations between the ownership-transfer barriers and the semaphore signal/wait. The reduced matrix uses eight extra write stages, nine extra read stages, and six resources. Leaves are generated by the sync2-only block in [`createTests`](../../../modules/vulkan/synchronization/vktSynchronizationOperationMultiQueueTests.cpp#L1538-L1644); the case logic is [`IntermediateBarrierCase`](../../../modules/vulkan/synchronization/vktSynchronizationOperationMultiQueueTests.cpp#L1330-L1436).

## Execution and Verification

The [`MultiQueues`](../../../modules/vulkan/synchronization/vktSynchronizationOperationMultiQueueTests.cpp#L99-L250) helper creates a custom device with up to two queues per family and selects write/read queue pairs whose queue flags support the operations. Ordinary fence and binary-semaphore cases create one shared resource; timeline cases build a chain of resources and copy operations across the selected queues, while `intermediate_barrier_use_all` adds extra operations to that chain. Each case records its operations and inserts QFOT release/acquire barriers for exclusive resources when required. Operation stage/access/layout requirements come from the shared operation framework in [`vktSynchronizationOperation.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/synchronization/vktSynchronizationOperation.cpp).

After the read completes, expected data from the write operation is compared with observed data from the read operation using `deMemCmp`. Indirect-buffer reads pass when their counter is at least the expected value. Any mismatch for a valid queue pair returns `tcu::TestStatus::fail`; otherwise the case passes.

## Requirements and Skips

Synchronization2 cases require `VK_KHR_synchronization2`; timeline cases require timeline semaphore support. Use-all-stages cases require `VK_KHR_maintenance8`, and maintenance9 cases require `VK_KHR_maintenance9`. Image format, sample count, operation support, queue flags, and available queue families are checked per case. Vulkan SC builds exclude all use-all-stages and maintenance9 variants, and exclude the intermediate family.

## Mustpass Coverage

The default mustpass lists contain both registered roots and generated suffixes:

- [`synchronization.txt`](../../../mustpass/main/vk-default/synchronization.txt) includes `dEQP-VK.synchronization.op.multi_queue...` leaves, including `_concurrent_maintenance9` where supported.
- [`synchronization2.txt`](../../../mustpass/main/vk-default/synchronization2.txt) includes `dEQP-VK.synchronization2.op.multi_queue...` leaves, including sync2 `_exclusive_use_all_stages` and `intermediate_barrier_use_all` entries.

The files are generated/maintained separately from the wiki; verify exact leaf coverage against the source matrix when changing registration.
